title: Manager –  Yarn & Fabric Outsourcing
description:
**Department:**
Sourcing / Procurement - Textiles
  
  
**Designation:**
Manager - Yarn and Fabric Outsourcing
  
  
**Experience:**
5-8 Years (preferred)
  
  
**Qualification:**
B.Tech / B.Sc. in Textile Technology or a relevant degree in Textiles
  
  
**Location:**
Perundurai / Coimbatore
  
  
**Industry:**
Textile / Home Textiles / Fabric Manufacturing
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are looking for an experienced and proactive Manager to handle dyed woven fabric and yarn outsourcing activities, ensuring timely material procurement, vendor coordination, quality compliance, and production schedule adherence. The candidate will be responsible for end-to-end follow-up with external suppliers, monitoring order status, coordinating with internal departments, and ensuring materials are delivered as per quality, cost, and delivery requirements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Outsourcing & Vendor Management: Identify, evaluate, and coordinate with external suppliers for dyed woven fabrics and yarn. Maintain strong relationships with vendors, processing units, dyeing units, and textile manufacturers. Follow up on purchase orders, production schedules, material availability, and delivery commitments. Negotiate pricing, lead times, and commercial terms in coordination with the procurement team.
* Dyed Woven Fabric Follow-up

Monitor fabric processing activities, including dyeing, finishing, and quality inspection. Follow up on fabric production status, shade approvals, lab dips, and bulk production approvals. Ensure fabric specifications, colour consistency, shrinkage, and other quality parameters meet requirements. Coordinate with suppliers to resolve fabric quality issues, delays, and reprocessing requirements.
  
  

* Yarn Outsourcing Follow-up

Coordinate with yarn suppliers and spinning mills for timely procurement and delivery. Monitor yarn specifications, counts, blends, quality parameters, and order quantities. Track yarn availability, dispatch schedules, and delivery status. Ensure yarn quality and specifications meet production requirements.
  
  

* Production Planning & Coordination

Coordinate with production, merchandising, purchase, quality, stores, and logistics teams. Track material requirements against production plans and customer delivery schedules. Prepare and maintain outsourcing status reports, pending order reports, and delivery trackers. Proactively identify potential delays and take corrective action to avoid production interruptions.
  
  

* Quality, Cost & Delivery Control

Ensure outsourced materials meet approved quality standards and specifications. Monitor supplier performance in terms of quality, cost, delivery, and responsiveness. Handle supplier complaints, rejections, shortages, and corrective actions. Maintain proper documentation of purchase orders, supplier confirmations, inspection reports, and delivery records.
  
  
**Required Skills**
Strong knowledge of dyed woven fabrics, textile processing, and yarn. Experience in outsourcing follow-up, vendor coordination, and material procurement. Good understanding of fabric dyeing, finishing, shade matching, and yarn specifications.
  
  
Strong follow-up, negotiation, communication, and problem-solving skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple departments and manage time-sensitive deliveries. Proficiency in MS Excel and ERP systems for order tracking and reporting.
  
  
**Preferred Candidate Profile**
Candidates with experience in textile mills, home textiles, woven fabric manufacturing, or textile sourcing are preferred. Practical experience handling external dyeing and processing units, fabric suppliers, and spinning mills.
  
  
Strong ability to manage multiple orders and ensure on-time material availability. Candidates with a proactive approach to vendor follow-up and production coordination will be preferred.
  
  
Further Information, please Contact Mr.Saravanan, Mobile or WhatsApp no +91 638 374 3335 or Send resume at jobs@talentseeds.in

title: Associate Process Manager
description:
**Specialism –**
Reference Data

Job Location - Coimbatore

As part of our Reference Data leadership team, you will be working with our client partners to improve processes and controls that build capacity and scale. Your role will contribute to analyse complex problems and come up with lateral solutions using tools like Bloomberg, Reuters etc. To classify and categorize data, identify security pricing, capture data which is required and used while making a trade.

The candidate must possess in-depth functional knowledge of the process area and apply it to operational scenarios to provide effective solutions. He/she must be able to identify discrepancies and propose optimal solutions by using a logical, systematic, and sequential methodology. It is vital to be open-minded towards inputs and views from team members and to effectively lead, control, and motivate groups towards company objects. Additionally, he/she must be self-directed, proactive and seize every opportunity to meet internal and external customer needs and achieve customer satisfaction by effectively auditing processes, implementing best practices and process improvements, and utilizing the frameworks and tools available. Goals and thoughts must be clearly and concisely articulated and conveyed, verbally and in writing, to clients, colleagues, subordinates, and supervisors.

The ideal candidate should possess strong business understanding of finance industry with special focus on Data Management, Operational Security Pricing, Data Quality Management. He/She should be good with numbers and ability to derive information from data with excellent multi-tasking and creative problem solving. He/She should have strong capabilities in PowerPoint, MS Word and MS Excel and should be able to build domain expertise and lead from the front with the ability to work under pressure, handle multiple priorities and work as part of the team.

**Reference Data- Associate Process Manager- Responsibilities**

* Review and analyse trade data between risk and finance systems
* Check for completeness, accuracy and consistency to identify the set of genuine breaks
* Investigate the genuine breaks for root cause and facilitate resolution and decision support, wherever necessary
* Provide support on the change and new business requests received from various RFDAR/non-RFDAR teams by assessing the business requirements, performing testing, providing SME support
* Apply data normalization methods such as filtering, standardization, enrichment, aggregation
* Lead discussions with the internal teams to highlight breaks
* Lead and take appropriate action post liaising with the respective stakeholder
* Create reports / metrics / analysis to cover the Daily / Weekly / Monthly requests
* Mailbox Management / Queue Management
* Build domain expertise and lead from the front.
* Independently handle clients and client calls– establish self as a valued partner.
* Escalate issues to client and internal managers to bring issues to their attention in a short span of time to avoid client escalation
* Help knowledge management endeavour by sharing process knowledge and best practices within the teams

**Minimum Qualifications-**

* Graduation (Bcom, BBA, BBM, BCA) / Post Graduation (Mcom, MBA, PGDM)
* 3 to 10 years of experience in handling team of minimum 10 members and has good experience and knowledge of Data Management, Security Pricing, and Quality Management.
* Conceptualize, design and deliver high-quality solutions and insightful analysis on a variety of projects ranging in both complexity and scope
* Knowledge of / prior experience with offshoring processes and methodologies highly preferred
* Seeking a challenging new position in a dynamic high growth company and industry.
* Should be good with logical and quantitative abilities.

**Preferred Qualifications-**

* Ability to manage and complete specific tasks with minimal direction
* Should be able to act fast and decisively when dealing with critical situations – ability to read situations and act in minutes
* Willingness to continuously learn, upgrade skills and stay relevant to business demands
* Excellent interpersonal skills – ability to network and earn confidence of diverse Client personnel plus interaction with and management of eClerx India based operations team.

eClerx provides critical business operations services to over fifty global Fortune 500 clients, including some of the world’s leading companies across financial services, cable & telecom, retail, fashion, media & entertainment, manufacturing, travel & leisure, software, and high-tech. Incorporated in 2000, eClerx is one of India’s leading process management and data analytics companies and is today traded on both the Bombay and National Stock Exchanges of India. eClerx employs 9,500-plus people across its global sites in the US, UK, India, Italy, Germany, Singapore, Thailand.

For financial organizations across the world, eClerx Markets offers consulting, technological innovation, and process management expertise to uniquely solve operational challenges. With nearly two decades of industry experience complemented by the application of smart automation and robotics, our team of experts deliver holistic solutions across the trade life cycle, change management, data analytics, compliance, cash securities operations, document digitization and generation, and outreach.

You will be actively managing our field supervisors, keeping external installation vendors in line, tracking local inventory, and dealing directly with DISCOMs to get net-meters approved. Prior experience managing rooftop solar projects is mandatory.

**What You Will Actually Do Day-to-Day**
:

* **End to End Project Execution**
  : Oversee the day-to-day deployment of multiple residential & commercial rooftop solar projects simultaneously across Tamil Nadu. Ensure all projects are completed on time, within budget, and to premium quality standards.
* **Team Leadership**
  : Manage, mentor, and deploy a distributed team of site surveyors, field engineers, and installation supervisors. Establish strict safety protocols, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and quality checkpoints.
* **Vendor & (I&C) Management**
  : Build, onboard, and manage a robust network of local Installation & Commissioning (I&C) teams and labor contractors. Negotiate rates, monitor daily progress, and audit their workmanship.
* **Procurement & Inventory**
  : Coordinate regional supply chain logistics. Manage structural, electrical, and component inventory (modules, inverters, structures, BoS) to ensure zero site-delivery delays while minimizing local warehousing overheads.
* **DISCOM Liaisoning & Subsidy paperwork**
  : Own the relationship with DISCOM officials to ensure seamless site inspections, structure approvals, and fast net-metering synchronization.

**What We Are Looking For:**

* **Education**
  : B.Tech / Diploma in Electrical, Civil, or Mechanical Engineering.
* **Experience**

title: IT Lead -IT Engineering
description:
**Job Title:**
IT Lead -IT Engineering

**Location:**
Bangalore/ Coimbatore

**Immediate joiners or notice period of less than 30 days are needed**

**This Role:**

The IT Lead, IT Engineering leads the engineering of LogixHealth's Microsoft cloud and workplace platforms: Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Azure including Azure Virtual Desktop, Microsoft Purview data protection, ITSM tooling and automation. The role owns everything beyond day-to-day operations in a healthcare technology environment that handles Protected Health Information (PHI).

This is a strategic and technical leadership role. The Lead sets the standards and roadmap for these platforms, is the technical authority on design decisions and major incidents, stays hands-on for the most complex work, and leads and mentors the IT engineers who deliver the rest. The Lead turns business and security requirements into a practical platform plan with costs, risks and timelines for the IT Infrastructure Leadership, and serves all LogixHealth locations.

**Key Responsibilities:**

***Strategy, Standards and Roadmap***

* Own the architecture, design standards and 12 to 24 month roadmap for identity, endpoint management, data protection, cloud and virtual desktop and IT tooling; translate business, security and compliance requirements into options and investment cases with cost, risk and timeline.
* Provide input to budgeting, Azure forecasts, Microsoft licensing and tooling decisions; lead projects end to end (requirements, design, pilot, phased rollout, handover) and act as technical approver in design and change reviews.

***Platform Ownership (Entra ID, Intune, Purview, Azure, AVD)***

* Own Entra ID standards: Conditional Access framework, MFA and authentication strategy, Privileged Identity Management, access reviews, application integration and hybrid identity (Entra Connect).
* Own endpoint and data protection standards: Autopilot, Autopatch, configuration and compliance policies, Defender for Endpoint, application deployment, Purview DLP and encryption, for Windows and macOS.
* Own Azure Virtual Desktop design and operation (host pools, image strategy, FSLogix, autoscaling, capacity, cost and monitoring) and the supporting Azure resources.

***Security Hardening, Patch and Vulnerability Management***

* Own the hardening standard (Microsoft or CIS baselines, Defender for Endpoint and ASR rules, Credential Guard, firewall, device control, encryption, Windows LAPS) and the patch programme: policy and SLAs by severity, monthly cycle, third-party patching, maintenance windows, exception governance and zero-day response.
* Own the vulnerability management programme: intake from Defender Vulnerability Management or scanners, prioritisation, remediation SLAs, exception and risk-acceptance register with Security, verified closure and monthly posture reporting with owners and dates for gaps.

***ITSM Tooling and Automation***

* Own the engineering of IT tooling, including ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus design and its integrations with Intune, Entra ID and Microsoft 365, plus monitoring, reporting and self-service automation.
* Set automation and documentation standards for the team (PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, Azure DevOps or Git) and introduce Infrastructure as Code where it adds value.

***Incident, Compliance and Team Leadership***

* Act as technical lead on major incidents affecting these platforms and on the technical response to security incidents with Information Security; manage Microsoft and vendor escalations; own ISO 27001, SOC 2 and HIPAA evidence for the platform controls.
* Lead, mentor and develop the IT engineering team: allocate work, review designs, provide escalation support and build capability across the platforms.

**Qualifications:**

The following requirements are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or ability required to perform this job successfully. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the duties.

***Required (Mandatory):***

* B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics or a related engineering discipline.
* 9 to 12 years in IT infrastructure or cloud engineering, including 2 to 3 years as technical lead, with at least 4 years hands-on on Microsoft 365 and Azure in a design and build (engineering) capacity rather than support-only roles.
* Strong hands-on Microsoft Entra ID: Conditional Access design, MFA and authentication methods, PIM, access reviews, enterprise application SSO and hybrid identity.
* Strong hands-on Microsoft Intune: Autopilot, compliance and configuration policies, Autopatch or update rings, Defender for Endpoint, macOS management.
* Strong hands-on Azure Virtual Desktop: architecture, host pools, image lifecycle, FSLogix, autoscaling, security and monitoring, with working knowledge of the Azure platform (networking, storage, monitoring, RBAC, cost).
* Proven ownership of patch and vulnerability management for an endpoint or VDI estate: hardening standards, Defender Vulnerability Management or Tenable, Rapid7 or Qualys, SLA-based remediation, exception governance and reporting.
* PowerShell and Microsoft Graph; proven ability to define a roadmap, lead major incidents, run design reviews and explain architecture, cost and risk to senior management.
* Work from office; shifts and on-call as required for a 24×7 healthcare operation; travel between Coimbatore and Bangalore when needed.

***Preferred (Good to Have):***

* Infrastructure as Code: owning a Terraform (azurerm, azuread) or Bicep practice with module standards, remote state, Git pull-request workflow, pipeline deployment and drift detection, including identity objects managed as code.
* Deeper Azure platform design (vNets, NSGs, private endpoints, Azure Files, Compute Gallery, Log Analytics) and Azure DevOps or GitHub CI/CD; Windows 365, Nerdio, Citrix or VMware Horizon to AVD migration.
* Microsoft Purview DLP and Defender XDR depth; ITSM tool design or integration (ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus, ServiceNow or similar); experience moving from AD-dependent estates to cloud-native Entra ID and Intune; healthcare, HIPAA or other regulated environment.

***Preferred Certifications (Good to Have):***

Microsoft AZ-104 or AZ-305, MD-102, SC-300, AZ-140; ITIL Foundation; HashiCorp Terraform Associate.

About Elimai.ai

Elimai.ai is an AI-native enterprise technology company building intelligent AI agents for the fashion and apparel industry.

Our platform helps apparel manufacturers and exporters streamline product development, sampling, costing, pre-production approvals, and merchandising workflows. By automating email processing, technical document interpretation, approval tracking, and manual Excel updates, we help teams improve productivity, reduce errors, and gain real-time operational visibility.

We are now expanding our solutions to support fashion brands, buying offices, and sourcing organizations, enabling seamless collaboration across the fashion supply chain.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced
**Apparel Product Development & Merchandising Domain Specialist**
with strong knowledge of garment product development, sourcing, technical merchandising, and brand-side operations.

This is a domain expertise and product development role, not a conventional merchandising execution position. The selected candidate will work closely with our product, AI, and engineering teams to translate real-world apparel industry workflows into intelligent software solutions.

We are looking for someone who understands not only
**what merchandisers do, but why they do it, how decisions are made, and where existing processes can be improved.**

Why Join Elimai.ai?

* Contribute directly to AI products built specifically for the apparel industry.
* Work closely with product leaders and AI engineering teams.
* Apply real-world merchandising experience to solve industry-wide operational challenges.
* Help shape technology for fashion brands, sourcing offices, and manufacturers.
* Play a meaningful role in transforming traditional fashion supply chain workflows through AI.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Apparel Industry Domain Expertise**

* Provide practical domain knowledge across product development, merchandising, sourcing, sampling, costing, and pre-production activities.
* Explain end-to-end workflows followed by fashion brands, buying offices, and apparel manufacturers.
* Identify differences between brand-side and manufacturer-side merchandising operations.
* Document industry terminology, business processes, approval requirements, and operational challenges.

**2. Brand-Side Sourcing & Merchandising Workflows**

* Map how fashion brands manage seasonal collections, product development calendars, style development, and sourcing activities.
* Explain vendor selection, quotation comparison, target costing, and supplier coordination processes.
* Understand how brands coordinate with multiple factories and track product development progress.
* Identify operational challenges in brand-to-manufacturer communication, sample management, and approval tracking.

**3. AI Product Development & Workflow Automation**

* Collaborate with AI engineers and product teams to convert merchandising processes into software requirements.
* **Identify repetitive manual activities suitable for AI-driven automation.**
* Help design AI agents for sampling, costing, technical document processing, approvals, and workflow tracking.
* Validate AI-generated information against actual apparel industry practices.
* Define business rules, workflow exceptions, and scenarios requiring human intervention.
* Provide practical feedback to improve product accuracy, usability, and industry relevance.

**4. Product Testing & Validation**

title: AI Evaluation Lead (Part Time Contract, Engagement Based)
description:
**About us**

DATACLAP is an AI data services company based in Coimbatore, working with AI companies across North America and Europe on data annotation, human in the loop workflows, RLHF and MLOps. We're building a dedicated AI evaluation practice covering LLMs, AI agents, computer vision and audio models, and we're looking for experienced practitioners to lead client engagements and mentor our engineering team.

**The role**

This is a part time, engagement based contract role, not full time employment. You'll lead AI evaluation projects for our clients, typically 8 to 15 hours a week per engagement. You'll design the evaluation approach, guide a team of junior engineers who do the hands on execution, review their work, and own the quality of what we deliver. You'll also help us turn every engagement into reusable methods, so the practice gets stronger with each project.

**What you'll do**

* Scope evaluation projects with clients: understand the model, the use case, and what "good" looks like for them
* Design evaluation frameworks, including metrics, test sets, rubrics, and pass/fail criteria
* Build or guide the building of golden datasets and evaluation harnesses
* Design and calibrate LLM as a judge setups, and know when human evaluation is needed instead
* Plan red teaming, safety and robustness testing where relevant
* Lead and mentor 2 to 5 junior engineers per engagement through regular reviews and working sessions
* Review results, catch flawed methodology, and present findings to client stakeholders
* Document each engagement as a playbook, rubric set or template the team can reuse

**What we're looking for**

* 6+ years in machine learning, data science or applied AI, with at least 2 years focused on model evaluation, benchmarking or quality assurance of ML systems
* Hands on experience evaluating LLM applications: RAG systems, chatbots, agents or fine tuned models
* Solid grounding in evaluation fundamentals: metric selection, test set design, statistical significance, inter annotator agreement, and data leakage
* Experience with eval tooling such as DeepEval, Ragas, Promptfoo, Inspect, Langfuse, Braintrust or EleutherAI's evaluation harness (or custom built equivalents)
* Experience leading or mentoring engineers, and comfort reviewing others' work critically
* Clear written and spoken communication; you'll present findings to international clients
* Python proficiency

**Strong plus**

* Computer vision evaluation experience (detection, segmentation, tracking; metrics such as mAP and IoU; tools such as FiftyOne or CVAT)
* Audio or speech model evaluation (word error rate, speaker diarization, MOS style human ratings)
* Experience with AI agent evaluation: task completion, tool use, multi step trajectories
* Familiarity with AI governance frameworks such as the EU AI Act or NIST AI RMF
* Prior consulting or client facing delivery experienc
  **e**

**Engagement mode**

* Contract basis, paid per engagement, with a monthly retainer during active projects
* Flexible hours, mostly remote, with occasional in person sessions in Coimbatore
* Start with a short paid pilot project so we can both see if it's a fit
* If you're currently employed, please make sure your employer permits outside consulting work

**How to app**
ly

Send us a short note (not just a CV) describing one model evaluation you designed or led: what you were evaluating, how you decided what to measure, and one thing that surprised you in the results.

title: Architect
description:
Architect – Sales, Interiors & Project Quality

Department: Architecture, Sales & Projects

Location: Coimbatore

Experience: 3–6 years preferred

Reports to: Managing Director / Project Head

1. Job Objective

To drive apartment sales and interior sales while coordinating architectural design, construction progress, and site quality. The candidate will work closely with customers, the sales team, contractors, vendors, and the project team to support revenue generation, timely execution, and superior quality.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Apartment Sales & Customer Conversion – 30%

• Handle enquiries for Sanbrix residential projects and convert prospects into bookings.

• Explain floor plans, layouts, specifications, amenities, pricing, and project advantages to prospective buyers.

• Conduct customer meetings and site visits; follow up on leads, coordinate negotiations, and assist in closing sales.

• Work with the marketing team to improve lead conversion and maintain a daily lead follow-up report and weekly sales pipeline.

• Prepare and present floor plans, unit options, and customised layouts to customers.

• Coordinate with documentation and accounts teams for booking formalities and customer collections.

B. Interior Sales & Design – 20%

• Identify interior design and execution opportunities among apartment buyers.

• Present interior packages, material selections, 3D views, and design concepts.

• Prepare interior proposals, estimates, BOQs, and quotations.

• Coordinate with customers to finalise layouts, finishes, furniture, lighting, and materials.

• Follow up on quotations and convert them into confirmed interior orders.

• Coordinate with interior contractors, vendors, and execution teams to deliver work as per approved designs, budget, and timelines.

C. Site Progress & Project Coordination – 25%

• Inspect project sites regularly and monitor progress against the approved schedule.

• Coordinate with the Project Manager, site engineers, contractors, structural consultants, and MEP consultants.

• Communicate architectural drawings and construction details clearly to the execution team.

• Identify drawing discrepancies, site issues, and bottlenecks; ensure timely resolution.

• Prepare weekly progress reports listing completed work, pending work, responsible persons, and target dates.

• Track material requirements, design changes, and customer-specific modifications; escalate delays, cost overruns, and technical issues to the Project Head.

D. Construction Quality & Design Compliance – 20%

• Inspect work against approved drawings, specifications, and project standards.

• Check critical work stages, including masonry, plastering, waterproofing, tiling, painting, joinery, and finishing.

• Verify dimensions, levels, alignment, finishes, and workmanship.

• Document defects in a snag list, assign responsibility, and track closure deadlines.

• Coordinate inspections and ensure defects are corrected before subsequent work proceeds where appropriate.

• Ensure customer-requested changes are approved and documented before execution.

• Maintain quality inspection records and support pre-handover inspections.

E. Reporting & Team Coordination – 5%

• Submit daily activity reports and weekly performance summaries.

• Attend sales, design, and project review meetings.

• Maintain updated records of enquiries, bookings, interior proposals, site progress, and quality issues.

• Coordinate across departments and take ownership of assigned tasks through to completion.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance Area

Measurement

Apartment sales

Bookings and sales value achieved against assigned target

Lead conversion

Enquiry-to-site-visit and site-visit-to-booking conversion

Customer follow-up

Timely follow-up and updates for all assigned leads

Interior sales

Interior packages sold and order value achieved

Interior conversion

Quotations converted into confirmed orders

Site progress

Milestones completed as per approved schedule

Quality control

Defects documented, resolved, and repeat defects prevented

Reporting

Daily reports and weekly reviews submitted on time

Suggested initial monthly standards

• Apartment and interior sales targets to be fixed monthly based on assigned projects, available inventory, and lead allocation.

• 100% of assigned milestones tracked, with delays escalated promptly.

• All critical defects documented and closed within agreed timelines.

• 100% of assigned leads updated in the CRM or sales tracker.

Sales targets should be fixed separately for each project and reviewed monthly.

4. Qualifications & Skills

• B.Arch degree from a recognised institution.

• 3–6 years of relevant experience preferred.

• Prior apartment or residential property sales experience is essential.

• Experience in interior design sales, estimation, or execution is highly desirable.

• Good understanding of architectural drawings, construction methods, finishes, and materials.

• Ability to prepare presentations, BOQs, quotations, and customer proposals.

• Strong communication, negotiation, and customer-handling skills.

• Proficiency in AutoCAD; knowledge of SketchUp, 3D visualisation, and Excel is an advantage.

• Willingness to travel between project sites and meet customers.

5. Behavioural Expectations – Sanbrix Standards

QUALITY

• Never compromise on construction quality or customer commitments. Identify issues early and ensure corrective action.

HONESTY

• Give customers accurate information on specifications, pricing, timelines, and deliverables. Maintain transparent reporting.

OWNERSHIP

• Take responsibility from the first customer enquiry through sales closure, interior delivery, and quality follow-up.

• Do not wait for repeated instructions. Follow through until the task is completed.

• No complacency, avoidable delays, or unresolved issues.

6. Reporting & Review System

• Daily: Leads contacted, customer meetings, site visits, quotations issued, site inspections, and issues requiring action.

• Weekly: Apartment sales pipeline, interior sales pipeline, site progress, quality observations, pending drawings, and overdue tasks.

• Monthly: Sales value achieved, interior orders secured, conversion ratios, milestone performance, defect closure, and customer feedback.

Every pending task must have a clearly identified owner, deadline, status, and expected result.

7. Success in This Role

The successful candidate will increase apartment and interior revenue, improve customer conversion, reduce site-level coordination gaps, and help ensure Sanbrix projects are delivered with the required quality and professionalism.

“At Sanbrix, the responsibility does not end with a drawing, a sale, or a site inspection. It ends when the commitment is delivered.”

SANBRIX PROPERTIES | QUALITY • HONESTY • OWNERSHIP

EY’s financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client’s decision-making.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The Senior Delivery Manager & Data Architect is a senior client-facing leader accountable for the end-to-end delivery and architectural integrity of complex data, analytics, cloud, and AI transformation programmes. The role combines delivery governance, commercial ownership, stakeholder leadership, and hands-on architecture oversight to translate business priorities into secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-effective data solutions.
  
  
The incumbent will act as the single point of accountability for delivery outcomes while defining target-state data architectures, engineering standards, governance controls, and transformation roadmaps. The role requires the ability to move confidently between executive discussions, programme governance, solution design, and technical assurance.

* Own end-to-end delivery of large, multi-workstream data and analytics programmes from discovery and mobilisation through implementation, transition, and benefits realisation.

* Define integration and ingestion patterns for batch, near-real-time, event-driven, CDC, API, and file-based workloads.

* Ensure solutions meet requirements for scalability, resilience, availability, observability, interoperability, security, privacy, maintainability, and cost optimisation.
* Establish governance principles covering data ownership, stewardship, classification, lineage, metadata, master and reference data, retention, and policy enforcement.
* Embed data quality controls, reconciliation, auditability, privacy-by-design, role-based access, encryption, and regulatory compliance into solution architecture and delivery.
* Partner with cyber security, risk, legal, compliance, and operations teams to ensure controls are demonstrable and audit-ready.
* Build trusted relationships with C-suite sponsors, business leaders, product owners, technology executives, and delivery partners.
* Translate complex business needs into clear solution options, investment cases, roadmaps, and outcome-based delivery plans.
* Facilitate executive workshops, architecture forums, steering committees, and difficult decision-making conversations.
* Own or support proposals, solution shaping, estimates, statements of work, delivery models, contract assumptions, and commercial negotiations.
* Manage programme financials, forecasting, burn, margin, resourcing, vendors, and third-party commitments.
* Identify opportunities for account growth, reusable assets, accelerators, and follow-on transformation initiatives.
* Lead multidisciplinary teams of architects, data engineers, platform engineers, analysts, data scientists, DevOps specialists, quality engineers, and project managers.
* Set clear accountabilities, create a high-performance culture, mentor senior practitioners, and develop succession and capability plans.
* Promote engineering excellence, knowledge sharing, reusable patterns, continuous improvement, and responsible use of data and AI.
* Contribute to hiring, workforce planning, communities of practice, thought leadership, and organisational capability development.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* Typically 15+ years of technology experience, including substantial experience delivering enterprise data programmes and operating in a lead data or solution architecture capacity.
* Demonstrable ownership of large, complex, multi-team programmes with responsibility for delivery governance, senior stakeholders, budgets, quality, and commercial outcomes.
* Strong experience designing and delivering cloud data platforms on Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud; deep expertise in at least one ecosystem is essential.
* Proven experience with modern data platforms and technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Synapse Analytics, Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, Kafka, cloud object storage, and modern BI tools.
* Advanced knowledge of SQL and strong working understanding of Python or PySpark, data integration, distributed processing, DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and observability.
* Solid command of data modelling, metadata management, data quality, master data management, governance, privacy, security, and lifecycle management.
* Experience architecting AI-ready data foundations and integrating machine learning, generative AI, vector, semantic, ontology, or knowledge graph capabilities is desirable.
* Excellent executive communication, consulting, negotiation, facilitation, decision-making, and conflict-resolution skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Cloud architecture or data engineering certification in Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or Snowflake certification.
* TOGAF, DAMA/CDMP, or an equivalent data or enterprise architecture credential.
* PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, Scrum, or an equivalent programme or Agile delivery certification.
* ITIL certification is advantageous for roles with service transition or operational accountability.
* Delivery against agreed outcomes, milestones, budget, quality standards, and contractual commitments.
* Architecture compliance, reduction in technical debt, and adoption of reusable standards and patterns.
* Platform reliability, performance, security, data quality, observability, and unit-cost improvement.
* Stakeholder confidence, client satisfaction, benefits realisation, and successful adoption of delivered capabilities.
* Team engagement, capability growth, predictable staffing, and development of future technical and delivery leaders.
* Commercial performance, pipeline contribution, and expansion of trusted client relationships.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. title: Content Team Lead
description:
**About Logbase**

Logbase builds a suite of apps that help Shopify merchants increase average order value and solve complex logistics problems. We serve 75,000+ merchants and are one of the fastest-growing companies in this space. We are moving upmarket toward larger Shopify Plus and Advanced merchants, and content is a big part of how those merchants find us, trust us and choose us.

**The role**

We are looking for a Content Lead to own the content engine end to end. That means content at every stage of the funnel, from website and landing pages and blogs that bring in merchants, to customer showcases that help larger merchants decide, to ebooks and whitepapers that go deeper. You will anchor the existing team, lead them to their success, and expand the team as needed with hiring or working with external flex teams, and report on what the content is actually delivering.

**What you will do**

* **Run the content engine.**

  Plan, produce and publish a steady mix of website and landing pages, blogs, customer showcases and case studies, ebooks and whitepapers, with a clear view of which piece serves which stage of the funnel.
* **Lead the team.**

  Manage content creators and freelance writers, set quality standards, review work and keep the calendar on track.
* **Scale with agencies.**

  Brief, manage and evaluate external content agencies so that volume grows without quality slipping.
* **Own the numbers.**

  Track performance for every content type, work out what is working and what is not, and share clear metrics and recommendations with management on a regular cadence.
* **Work across marketing.**

  Partner with Product Marketing on case studies and feature content, and with the wider team so content reflects how merchants actually talk about their problems.
* **Keep improving.**

Content that is published on schedule, produced at a consistent quality, and tied to results that management can see. You will be expected to report on output and on the impact of that output, not only on volume.

Please include samples of your content with your application. Send work that shows the range of what you have run, such as a blog, a customer story and a longer piece like an ebook or whitepaper, and tell us which results you were accountable for.

title: Project Manager
description:
**Quick Facts About the Role**

* **Role:**
  Project Manager
* **Location:**
  Coimbatore/Hyderabad
* **YOE:**
  3 - 7 years
* **Skills:**
  Expertise in project management methodologies, Agile methodologies, Scrum techniques, stakeholder management, and client interaction.
* **Benefits:**
  Learn more about our perks below.
* **Compensation:**
  Competitive compensation as per industry standards.

**Who we are**

We are Foxsense Innovations - a bunch of passionate developers that love solving complex business problems through products and tools we build from scratch. Weʼve been at it for over 7 years now, and weʼve serviced over 50 happy customers around the world, while also building several in-house micro-SaaS tools for the market (all of this while being bootstrapped and profitable). Our team is rapidly growing, and weʼre in an exciting phase of our 1-10 journey. This is an opportunity for anyone who wants to experience this journey with us.

**About the role**

We seek a project manager to handle our company’s ongoing projects. You will work closely with your team members to ensure that all project requirements, deadlines, and schedules are on track. Responsibilities include submitting project deliverables, preparing status reports, establishing effective project communication plans, and properly executing said plans.

**Responsibilities**

* Coordinating with cross-discipline team members to ensure all parties are on track with project requirements, deadlines, and schedules.
* Meeting with project team members to identify and resolve issues.
* Submitting project deliverables and ensuring that they adhere to quality standards.
* Preparing status reports by gathering, analyzing, and summarizing relevant information.
* Establish effective project communication plans and ensure their execution.
* Facilitating change requests to ensure that all parties are informed of the impacts on schedule and budget.
* Identifying and developing new opportunities with clients.
* Obtaining customer acceptance of project deliverables.
* Managing customer satisfaction within the project transition period.
* Conducting post-project evaluation and identifying successful and unsuccessful project elements.
* Prepare requirement documents, user flows and validate test cases.

**Requirements**

* A bachelor’s degree or master’s degree in a related field.
* 3+ years experience in project management in the Technology industry
* Ability to lead project teams of various sizes and see them through to completion.
* Ability to manage clients and expectations.
* Strong understanding of formal project management, agile methodologies and stakeholder management.
* Able to complete projects in a timely manner.
* Strong communication and literary skills.

**Bonus Skills**

* Basic understanding of coding, APIs, or cloud infrastructure to facilitate seamless communication with technical teams.
* Mastery of Agile methodologies to quickly adapt to changing priorities and drive project execution efficiently in a dynamic environment.

**Why work with us**

When you work with Foxsense Innovations, you donʼt just work a boring job. Our goal is to create a work environment that makes you want to brag about your work to your friends!

***Hereʼs why youʼll love working with us:***

* Unlimited sick leave policy, and a generous paid leave plan to ensure you get time off work whenever you need it
* A competitive and rewarding start-up culture that motivates you from day one, along with regular team-building activities
* Delicious lunch along with snacks and refreshments at office, so that hunger pangs never affect your A-game
* We have a yearly annual retreat for the team to unwind and enjoy - we went to Vagamon last year, who knows where we go this year!

**If that's not enough, there's always more!**

* Need a breather? Game with Foxes at the TT. There's a scoreboard!
* Our wholesome health care plans care for you - whenever, wherever.
* Embrace growth! Learn & grow from peers - You'll find budding freshers, seasoned veterans - you name it.
* We take unwinding as seriously as we do hustling - game nights are our way of downtime.
* Collaboration is vital for us - your value isn’t limited to your responsibilities! Feel free to lurk in other departments and share your thoughts!

**Weʼre glad youʼve made it this far! If you’re passionate about delivering successful projects, fostering collaboration, and driving growth in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, we’d love to hear from you.**

title: Production Supervisor
description:
**Job Summary**
 Responsible for supervising and managing day\-to\-day production activities involving MIG/TIG welding, riveting, gluing, and torque tightening processes. Ensure production targets, quality standards, safety requirements, and delivery schedules are achieved through effective manpower management, process monitoring, and coordination with Quality, PPC, Maintenance, and other departments.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Supervise daily production activities related to MIG \& TIG welding, riveting, gluing and torque tightening processes.
* Plan manpower and allocate operators/workers according to production requirements.
* Ensure production targets are achieved as per daily/monthly production plans.
* Monitor welding parameters such as current, voltage, wire feed speed, gas flow and welding sequence.
* Ensure proper execution of MIG/TIG welding, including weld quality, appearance and dimensional requirements.
* Supervise riveting operations and ensure correct rivet type, size, positioning and fastening quality.
* Monitor gluing/adhesive application, including surface preparation, adhesive quantity, curing time and bonding quality.
* Ensure torque tightening is carried out according to specified torque values using calibrated torque tools.
* Verify first\-piece and in\-process quality and coordinate with the Quality Department for inspection and corrective actions.
* Identify welding defects such as porosity, undercut, lack of fusion, cracks, spatter and improper weld profile and take corrective action.
* Ensure proper use and maintenance of jigs, fixtures, welding machines, riveting tools, adhesive equipment and torque tools.
* Monitor machine/tool breakdowns and coordinate with Maintenance for quick resolution.
* Ensure operators follow SOP, Work Instructions, Control Plans and process parameters.
* Maintain production records, rejection/rework records, downtime reports and shift production reports.
* Control material wastage and improve productivity through 5S, Kaizen and continuous improvement activities.
* Train and evaluate operators on welding, riveting, gluing and torque\-tightening processes.
* Ensure proper PPE and safety practices are followed in the production area.
* Coordinate with PPC, Quality, Maintenance, Stores and Engineering departments for smooth production flow.
* Investigate production and quality issues and implement root\-cause and corrective actions.
* Ensure proper shift handover and communicate pending issues to the next shift.
* Maintain discipline, attendance and work allocation within the production team.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* Diploma / ITI / BE in Mechanical, Production or related field.
* 3–7 years of experience in sheet\-metal fabrication/manufacturing production
* Strong practical knowledge of MIG \& TIG welding
* Experience in riveting, adhesive/gluing and torque tightening processes.
* Knowledge of welding defects and basic welding quality requirements.
* Ability to read engineering drawings, weld symbols and work instructions.
* Knowledge of measuring instruments and basic inspection methods.
* Experience in manpower handling and achieving production targets.
* Knowledge of 5S, Kaizen, Lean Manufacturing and safety practices.
* Good communication, problem\-solving and team\-management skills.

title: Independent Director
description:
**The mandate through a project’s life** 




  





 The company designs and manufactures process equipment used in food\-production environments. The Board needs an Independent Director who can govern the entire obligation created when an engineered system is sold—from interpretation of process requirements through fabrication, site integration, performance acceptance and long\-term service. Success cannot be measured only by dispatch: an apparently complete project can still carry unresolved hygiene, performance, documentation or margin exposure.
 



  





**Gate one: accepting the problem** 




  





 Before a bid becomes a contract, management must understand the customer’s product, process conditions, cleaning method, utilities, interfaces, throughput assumptions and acceptance criteria. The Director will challenge bid governance where requirements are incomplete, guarantees are broad or the proposed solution relies on untested assumptions. Commercial urgency should not bypass engineering review, capacity confirmation, site\-risk assessment or a clear allocation of interface responsibility.
 



  





 The Board should receive visibility into contractual exposure for delay, performance shortfall, contamination, consequential loss, intellectual property and changes in customer scope. Risk premiums and contingencies must be grounded in the actual project rather than applied mechanically.
 



  





**Gate two: freezing a cleanable design** 




  





 The appointee will seek assurance that hygienic design principles are built into equipment geometry, material choice, seals, welds, drainage, accessibility, instrumentation and cleaning validation. Design review should involve manufacturing, quality, service and commissioning, not remain isolated within engineering.
 



  





 Changes after design freeze need controlled technical and commercial assessment.
 



  





 Where digital controls or remote connections form part of the system, the Board must understand software ownership, access privileges, patching, data use and safe fallback. A cyber event that changes a process parameter can become a product\-safety event.
 



  





**Gate three: fabricating what was approved** 




  





 Material identity, surface condition, welding practice, outsourced treatment, calibration and inspection evidence all influence fitness for use. The Director will review how the company qualifies special processes, controls non\-conformance and preserves traceability. Schedule pressure must not move unfinished or conditionally accepted work downstream without named accountability and an agreed closure path.
 



  





 Management information should connect shop loading, material availability, engineering releases, rework and subcontractor performance. Reported project progress should represent earned completion, not expenditure or physical presence on the shop floor.
 



  





**Gate four: integrating at site** 




  





 Installation and commissioning often expose assumptions that were invisible during design. The Director will question site\-readiness checks, change control, safety planning, customer dependencies and escalation routes. Acceptance tests should be objective, witnessed and tied to the contracted duty. Punch lists must distinguish cosmetic completion from issues that prevent safe or hygienic operation.
 



  





 Revenue recognition, retention, warranty provision and project closure should reflect substantive acceptance and remaining obligations. The finance view and the project view must reconcile.
 



  





**Gate five: learning through service** 




  





 Warranty calls, spares demand, cleaning difficulties and repeat interventions contain product\-development intelligence. The appointee will encourage a closed loop from service into design standards, supplier decisions and commercial qualification. Aftermarket strategy should create genuine availability and performance value, not dependency through inaccessible information or restrictive practices.
 



  





**The enterprise decisions surrounding the gates** 




  





 The Director will participate in capacity, technology and market choices. They will evaluate whether modularisation, standard platforms, automation or strategic sourcing can improve delivery without concealing customer\-specific engineering. Working\-capital oversight will cover advances, milestone billing, long\-lead purchases, work in progress, claims and retentions. The Board will expect candid scenario analysis before expanding facilities or entering unfamiliar applications.
 



  





 Leadership review will include engineering authority, project\-management capability, quality independence, service responsiveness and succession for scarce technical roles. Safety, environmental performance and contractor governance will be treated as operating fundamentals.
 



  





**Experience and temperament** 




  





 The ideal candidate has senior responsibility in process equipment, food manufacturing, capital projects, industrial engineering, quality, operations, finance or project\-based business. Experience governing hygienic design, complex commissioning, contract risk or lifecycle service will be useful. The Board needs a person who can explore a technical issue deeply while preserving the distinction between oversight and execution.
 



  





 Candidates must be financially literate, conflict\-free and actively registered in the IICA Independent Directors Databank. Any relationship with customers, engineering consultants, component suppliers, contractors or competing equipment businesses must be declared.
 



  





**Candidate response** 




  





 Applications through India ID Exchange should include the Board profile, IICA confirmation and a brief explanation of how the candidate would determine whether a delayed project is suffering from execution weakness, defective commercial assumptions or both.

 Join a globally connected cybersecurity practice helping clients protect sensitive data in an AI\-driven world. title: Project Manager (Modular Furniture)
description:
**Furniture Project Manager**




  





**Job summary**




  





 This job describes an integrated model covering planning, in\-house manufacturing and installation, and its case study specifically describes the project manager controlling installation against the approved floor plan, coordinating readiness, inspecting the completed installation with the client, and obtaining handover.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:**




  




1. **Sales\-to\-Project Handover** 
 \- Take over confirmed PO, BOQ, quotation, approved drawings, specifications, finishes, and client commitments. Ensure complete and accurate project handover from Sales.
2. **Scope Validation** 
 \- Cross\-check PO, quotation, BOQ, and drawings. Identify and resolve quantity, specification, and scope discrepancies before execution.
3. **Project Kick\-Off** 
 \- Conduct project kick\-off meetings with Sales, Design, Engineering, Purchase, Maintenance, Production, QC, Logistics, Accounts and Installation teams. Define responsibilities, timelines, and deliverables.
4. **Project Planning \& Scheduling** 
 \- Prepare the master project schedule based on the committed delivery and handover date. Track project milestones and overall progress.
5. **Site Survey \& Verification** 
 \- Coordinate site measurements and verify site conditions, access, lift, loading, flooring, electrical, and other requirements. Ensure site readiness before execution.
6. **Drawing Coordination \& Approval** 
 \- Coordinate preparation and approval of GFC/AFC drawings. Ensure approved drawings are available before production.
7. **Engineering Release** 
 \- Coordinate detailed production drawings, BOMs, hardware, and special requirements. Ensure accurate and timely release of production information.
8. **Change \& Variation Management** 
 \- Control all changes and revisions through proper documentation and approvals. Evaluate impact on project cost, timeline, and resources.
9. **Material Readiness** 
 \- Monitor project\-specific and long\-lead materials with Purchase and Planning teams. Ensure materials are available as per the project schedule.
10. **Production Planning** 
 \- Coordinate production priorities based on project requirements and installation sequence. Ensure furniture is manufactured as per approved drawings and timelines.
11. **Production Monitoring** 
 \- Monitor planned versus actual production progress. Follow up with Production teams and resolve delays or bottlenecks.
12. **Quality Management** 
 \- Ensure pre\-dispatch inspection of dimensions, finishes, hardware, quantity, and functionality. Ensure products meet approved specifications and quality standards.
13. **Client \& Stakeholder Coordination** 
 \- Act as the primary project contact for clients, architects, PMCs, consultants, and contractors. Conduct regular project review meetings and maintain MOMs.
14. **Site Readiness Management** 
 \- Verify civil, flooring, painting, electrical, access, and other site requirements before dispatch. Confirm site readiness for installation.
15. **Dispatch \& Logistics Planning** 
 \- Plan floor\-wise/zone\-wise dispatch and delivery schedules. Coordinate packing, labeling, transportation, unloading, and material sequencing.
16. **Installation Planning** 
 \- Plan installation manpower, supervisors, tools, equipment, and work sequence. Set daily and weekly installation targets.
17. **Site Execution \& Monitoring** 
 \- Monitor daily installation activities and progress against approved drawings and schedules. Ensure installation quality, productivity, and safety requirements are maintained.
18. **Issue Resolution \& Escalation** 
 \- Identify and resolve shortages, damages, drawing mismatches, site obstructions, and other project issues. Track issues with responsible persons and target closure dates.
19. **Snag Management** 
 \- Conduct joint inspections with the client/PMC and prepare snag lists. Coordinate with concerned teams for timely snag closure.
20. **Project Handover \-** 
 Coordinate final inspection and completion of all pending works. Prepare handover documentation and obtain client sign\-off/handover certificate.
21. **Commercial Closure** 
 \- Support billing by providing dispatch, installation, handover, and approved variation documents. Coordinate closure of project\-related commercial requirements.

title: Fabrication & Production supervisor
description:
Company Overview:
   

  

 If a culture of excellence, innovation and ownership is what you’re searching for, consider putting your experience in motion at Flowserve. As an individual contributor, or as a leader of people, your enterprise mindset will ensure Flowserve’s position as the global standard in comprehensive flow control solutions. Here, your opportunity for professional development and industry leading rewards will be supported by our foundational commitments to the values of people first, integrity and safety. Thinking beyond opportunity and reward, at Flowserve, we are inspired by working together to create extraordinary flow control solutions to make the world better for everyone!
   

  

**Role Summary**
 The Production Supervisor leads day\-to\-day operations within the fabrication shop and final packaging area, ensuring safe, efficient, high\-quality production that meets customer delivery commitments. This role is responsible for supervising shop\-floor personnel, coordinating production activities across work centers, managing performance metrics, and driving continuous improvement through Lean and operational\-excellence practices.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Supervise fabrication shop and final packaging operations to achieve production, quality, safety, and on\-time delivery targets.
* Plan, prioritize, and schedule production activities across multiple work centers based on workload, capacity, material availability, and delivery commitments.
* Assign daily work to shop employees according to skill level, certifications, workload, and production priorities.
* Maintain and regularly update the shop\-floor skill matrix; identify training needs and coordinate employee development activities.
* Ensure compliance with Flowserve safety policies, safe work practices, and applicable environmental requirements.
* Promote a strong safety culture by conducting regular safety discussions, identifying risks, and ensuring corrective actions are implemented.
* Ensure production processes comply with ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 requirements, including adherence to documentation, traceability, inspection, and record\-retention procedures.
* Monitor and manage key operational KPIs, including utilization, efficiency, productivity, scrap, rework, quality performance, and schedule adherence.
* Analyze production losses, quality issues, and daily shop\-floor constraints; implement corrective and preventive actions using structured problem\-solving tools.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing and Operational Excellence initiatives, including AMEF/FMEA, Value Stream Mapping, 5S/6S, SMED, standard work, visual management, and continuous\-improvement activities.
* Apply statistical process\-control principles to monitor process performance, identify variation, and improve product quality.
* Support inventory management activities, including material availability, WIP control, inventory accuracy, and coordination with planning and supply chain teams.
* Ensure appropriate use of ERP systems, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Project, and other production\-planning tools for reporting, scheduling, and daily operational management.
* Review and interpret technical drawings, work instructions, manufacturing procedures, inspection plans, and customer specifications.
* Ensure fabrication and assembly activities comply with applicable engineering and industry standards, including API 610, ASME, AWS, and other relevant requirements.
* Support and oversee API and non\-API pump manufacturing processes, ensuring that approved procedures and quality requirements are consistently followed.
* Conduct training for shop employees on safety, quality, procedures, technical requirements, Lean practices, and standard work.
* Partner with Quality, Engineering, Supply Chain, Planning, and Maintenance teams to resolve operational issues and improve overall plant performance.
* Perform other duties as assigned.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum 5–7 years of relevant manufacturing experience, including experience supervising shop\-floor operations.
* Demonstrated experience in fabrication shop operations and final packaging activities.
* Working knowledge of CNC programming and machining/manufacturing processes.
* Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing and continuous\-improvement tools, including AMEF/FMEA, VSM, 5S/6S, SMED, and root\-cause analysis.
* Experience with production planning, capacity management, work\-center scheduling, and inventory/WIP management.
* Strong understanding of quality systems, process control, and ISO 9001/ISO 14001 requirements.
* Familiarity with API 610, ASME standards, and preferably AWS welding standards.
* Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, technical specifications, work instructions, and manufacturing procedures.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Office applications, ERP systems, and Microsoft Project or comparable scheduling software.
* Strong leadership, communication, problem\-solving, and team\-development skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in pump manufacturing, including API and non\-API pump production processes.
* Experience implementing Lean, Operational Excellence, or continuous\-improvement initiatives in a manufacturing environment.
* Exposure to statistical process control, quality tools, and structured corrective\-action methodologies.
* Knowledge of welding, fabrication, assembly, testing, and packaging processes for industrial equipment.

We invite you to put your talents and career in motion at Flowserve.
